structured_plan.G: Preparation only; no integrated candidate is selected. After research, compare correctness-validated candidates on the official wall-clock metric, combine only complementary improvements, and independently confirm the final program.
structured_plan.analysis: Choose N=2: the measured, correct baseline takes a mean 25.50 μs across three samples, and its decode path uses scalar table lookups and bytewise checks. With a one-thread budget, the useful distinct avenues are SIMD bulk decoding and a lower-overhead scalar decoder; parallelization is not a useful separate tree, and adding more decoder variants would overlap these two. The supplied target, compiler, and intrinsic availability are sufficient for planning; preserve correctness for every valid padded input size, handle padding and tails generically, respect the thread budget, write the count and exact decoded bytes on every call, and do not rely on the timed sizes or cached answers. Judge both timed sizes with correctness checks and comparable wall-clock measurements, then require independent confirmation of G.

children.objective: Explore an explicit AVX2 bulk decoder for valid Base64 quartets: vectorize character-to-sextet mapping and packing into decoded bytes, while handling the final padded quartet and any remainder without out-of-bounds reads or writes. Keep a generic path for sizes too small for a vector block. Preserve the output layout and single-thread budget. Measure correctness and wall-clock time at both official sizes; retain the approach only if its measured gain justifies its overhead.
children.subject: AVX2 bulk Base64 decoding

children.objective: Explore a strictly scalar, lower-overhead decoder as an alternative to SIMD: reduce per-character control flow and loop overhead using wordwise or unrolled quartet processing and efficient output packing. Handle padding and all generic remainders correctly, write only the specified output bytes, and preserve the single-thread budget. Measure correctness and wall-clock time at both official sizes and compare against the baseline and SIMD candidate.
children.subject: Scalar wordwise and unrolled decoding
